summary: 南宋最有恢复之志者，隆兴北伐无成而绍熙内禅守成，终功不遂志。
summary_en: The Southern Song ruler with the strongest ambition to recover the north, his Longxing campaign failed and his later years turned to consolidation; the aim remained unfulfilled.

timeline.summary_en: Seventh-generation descendant of Taizu, adopted by Gaozong.

timeline.summary_en: Zhang Jun led the campaign north; the defeat at Fuling broke the war party's momentum.

timeline.summary_en: The treaty with Jin changed the relation from sovereign-vassal to uncle-nephew with reduced tribute.

timeline.title: 内禅

timeline.title: 孝宗总评
timeline.summary: 为南宋诸帝中最思恢复者，惜时势不济、功不遂志。
timeline.summary_en: The Southern Song emperor most devoted to recovery, undone by circumstances.

bio_md:
# 宋孝宗 · 主要事迹

赵眘为[[n-song-tai-zu|太祖]]七世孙，秀王偁之子，绍兴三十二年（1162）受[[s-song-gao|高宗]]内禅即位，改元隆兴。他是南宋诸帝中最思恢复的一位，史称「卓然为南渡诸帝之称首」。

隆兴元年（1163）孝宗用张浚北伐，符离一役溃败，次年（1164）与金订「隆兴和议」：金宋改称叔侄，岁币减半。此后孝宗整军经武、留意民政，乾道、淳熙年间号称「乾淳之治」，然时机不济，恢复之志终未得遂。

淳熙十六年（1189）孝宗内禅，太子赵惇即位，是为[[s-song-guang|光宗]]；绍熙五年（1194）孝宗崩，谥号含「孝」字，以彰其事亲之诚。

bio_parts_en.value: and son of Prince Xiu, received the abdication from

in 1162, era Longxing. Historians call him the finest emperor of Southern Song - the one who most wished to recover the north.

In 1163 he sent Zhang Jun north; the rout at Fuling ended the campaign, and in 1164 the Longxing Treaty changed the Song-Jin relation from vassal to nephew (uncle-nephew rank) with halved tribute. Xiaozong then rebuilt the army and tended to governance; the Qiandao and Chunxi years are praised as an age of order. But the moment never came: the recovery dream went unfulfilled.

In 1189 he abdicated to his third son Zhao Dun,
; he died in 1194. His posthumous name carries the character for filial piety, honoring his devotion to Gaozong.
